description: This file contains a shell script designed to test the behavior of Git's rebase functionality under various broken or conflicting conditions, including missing or duplicate author information, conflicts during rebase, and file permission issues.

methods.name: create_conflict
methods.description: Creates a rebase conflict scenario by checking out branch2 based on branch2, then attempting to rebase onto branch1.

methods.name: check_resolve_fails
methods.description: Checks that attempting to continue a rebase after conflict resolution fails as expected.
